Any laugh removes all Composure.
If triggered by a Laugh Card, that card is played one additional time for each stack of Composure.

2002.description:
Whenever the sugar level reaches 1x, 2x, 3x, and so on, of your current health, an overflow occurs: the recovery phase is skipped and the sugar level is reset to zero.
If a suppression effect is active, it consumes one layer of suppression to prevent the overflow (the consumption increases by 1 each time it is triggered).

At the start of your turn, Milk Mouse will randomly perform one of the following actions:
70% chance
Deal 5 damage to a random enemy
Deal 3 damage to all enemies
Grant you 5 Block
25% chance
Grants you 1 Strength
Grants you 1 Agility
Restores 6 Health
5% chance
